description: Observed KeyMagic keyboard input rules. These are typing sequences, not PDF font-byte maps.

selection.optional: U+1022 through U+1027; U+1022 is not required
selection.partial_exception: Keep a draft with explicit gaps if an extended character was observed.
selection.discard: No complete core and no counted extra appears in the compiled variables or rules; include-only fragments are retained as dependencies.
selection.unverified: Potential target characters exist, but no applicable keyboard output was observed in the bounded probes.

generation.method: Original KeyMagic engine run from empty context with all printable US-layout single keys and key pairs; additional literal-context rules were probed when their components had observed standalone key sequences. Source files were compiled with icon metadata removed only.
generation.inputs: ASCII characters represent US-layout key presses; uppercase and shifted punctuation represent Shift. keymap contains all handled single-key outputs. An empty output can be a switch or an eaten key, not necessarily an output character.
limitations: A witness records complete final text, not a claim that every character was emitted separately; witness sequences are representative rather than exhaustive.

Only bounded sequences and selected literal contexts were probed; an unobserved character may be reachable in another context or with other modifiers. U+1009 is a core character as well as a listed example.
Each original source and compiled file is treated separately; legacy Zawgyi-font outputs remain as emitted and must not be assumed Unicode text.
No source keyboard was altered, and no keyboard input mapping is a PDF character-code map.
Licensing differs by upstream source; confirm redistribution rights for derived data as well as originals.
